coordinateSystem.sourceRectFormat: [left, top, width, height], 2 px padding around alpha >= 8 extent of each isolated cell.
coordinateSystem.rootPxFormat: [x,y] full atlas pixels. Find x median of alpha >= 64 in lowest 15 strong-alpha rows; choose lowest actual alpha >= 64 pixel within +/-3 px of that x. Root is a real visible pixel, excludes faint tails/fringe.

alpha.warning: Original contains alpha 1–3 vivid RGB fringe. No bright yellow/red at alpha >= 8. Preserve PNG; reject faint fringe in material alphaTest. Bounds/root exclude it.

parts.name: grassA
parts.description: Linked low wide patch of three unequal grass clusters; curved sage and straw strokes, uneven root baseline.

parts.name: grassB
parts.description: Taller wheat-grass tuft, narrow stems with broad painted seed heads; keep scarce.

parts.name: grassC
parts.description: Right-leaning grass mass, common wind gesture and fine curved foreground blades.

parts.name: grassD
parts.description: Short asymmetric grass tuft, fewer stems and mixed grey-sage/ivory strokes.

integration.distributionWarning: Four distinct grass parts, NO twig. Existing scene kind % 3 placement and name === twig logic cannot directly consume this atlas: first/fourth grass can overlap. Explicitly implement four unequal authored distributions before replacing atlas. Do not rename grassD to twig.
integration.material: sRGB, linear filtering/mipmaps, alphaTest about 0.05, native depth test and occlusion; matte lighting matching terrain. Do not disable depth test to conceal rooting problems.
integration.scale: At girl height 120 CSSpx: low about 10–14px high, tall 22–34px, wind tuft 17–25px, short 10–13px. Provisional guidance; native camera QA required.
integration.wind: Very small root-locked tip sway, no whole-card root translation.
integration.ground: Place root at actual terrain. Wide patch has irregular root baseline; avoid steep slopes and inspect real depth occlusion. Keep road/flower interaction area clear.
integration.runtimeLimit: Optional isolated vegetation art only. No scene/rig/controller/model/default bundle modified; not independent acceptance evidence.

validation.quadrantNote: Generated left column wider; measured custom sourceRects isolate all tufts without visible clipping.

assessment.improvementOverV12: More grouped fine curved strokes and asymmetric low patch, four meadow rhythms instead of a few broad aloe-like leaves.
assessment.limitations: Tall/leaning tufts remain dense painted masses and broad seed heads; at 10px blades may merge. Requires restrained authored distribution and native scene review; not finished design acceptance.
